hook: Mineart began as a mechanical engineer at Caterpillar in 1999 and spent nearly three decades rising through engineering, product strategy, and electric power leadership roles before being named Chief Technology Officer, now leading Cat Technology's push to integrate smarter, more connected machines across Caterpillar's global equipment lines.
name: Jaime Mineart

quote.text: We don't just build smarter machines, we create integrated, scalable solutions that deliver real-world results.

quick_facts: Chief Technology Officer and Senior Vice President at Caterpillar Inc.
Nearly 27-year career at Caterpillar, rising from engineering roles to company-wide CTO
Previously Senior Vice President of Caterpillar's Electric Power Division
Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from Purdue University

achievements.title: Senior Vice President, Electric Power Division (2024-2025)
achievements.impact: Led Caterpillar's electric power business through a period of energy transition demand growth.

achievements.title: Vice President, Retail Electric Power & Energy Transition Commercial Solutions (2021-2023)
